title: Intents
note: Questions the assistant is meant to answer (ai_intent).
rows: customer_last_order
The most recent order placed by a named customer
what did John Smith order last  |  show me Maria's latest purchase  |  when did bobby last buy something
customer_spend
How much a customer has spent, optionally within a period
how much has Maria spent  |  what is John Smith's lifetime value  |  how much did Aisha spend last month
order_contents
What was in a given order
what was in order A-1001  |  what did she actually buy  |  list the items on a1005
order_status
Where is a specific order right now
where is order A-1003  |  what is the status of my last order  |  has order a1012 shipped yet
product_stock
How many units of a product are on hand
how many wireless mice do we have  |  are we out of standing desks  |  stock level for the MBP
restock_list
Everything at or below its reorder level
what needs reordering  |  which products are running low  |  anything out of stock
revenue_for_period
Total revenue over a date range
how much did we make last week  |  revenue this month  |  what were sales yesterday
sales_by_rep
How a named sales rep is performing
how did Priya do this quarter  |  who is my top sales rep  |  how many orders has Sofia closed
top_products
Best selling products over a period
what sold best this month  |  top five products  |  what is our bestseller
sql: SELECT i.intent_name, i.description, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(j.v SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM JSON_TABLE(i.sample_utterances, '$[*]' COLUMNS (v VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')) j) AS sample_utterances FROM ai_intent i WHERE i.is_enabled ORDER BY i.intent_name
